$comment: PR44-SEC-05 (TASK-020 part 020-D): the shared corpus of the two raw-statement classifiers, the lint twin tools/eslint-rules/raw-sql-lexer.mjs (tools/lint/raw-sql-lexer.test.ts) and the TenantDb run-time guard apps/api/src/platform/db/raw-statement.ts (raw-statement.test.ts). Each case is one statement text as Prisma sends it (a template's ${...} values are $n). verdict: ok or the refused form. templates: the strings of a tagged template (PR54-SEC-01 (d)), which the TenantDb twin renders as Prisma does and the lint twin through templateText. 'residual' cases are ALLOWED by both classifiers on purpose and say why. SQL text inside a string literal is not read, so the functions that run SQL given as text (query_to_xml, query_to_xmlschema, query_to_xml_and_xmlschema, ts_stat, ts_rewrite) are refused by name (PR54-SEC-07), and pg_notify with NOTIFY (PR54-SEC-08). Residuals: function and procedure bodies, and the readers that build their own query from a name (table_to_xml*, schema_to_xml*, database_to_xml*, cursor_to_xml*: PR54-SEC-02 (b), due before TASK-073's first raw statement).
